command: cargo metadata --no-deps --format-version 1 && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features --message-format=json -- --cap-lints warn -W clippy::allow_attributes -W clippy::allow_attributes_without_reason -W clippy::await_holding_lock -W clippy::await_holding_refcell_ref -W clippy::borrowed_box -W clippy::cast_possible_truncation -W clippy::derive_ord_xor_partial_ord -W clippy::derived_hash_with_manual_eq -W clippy::exhaustive_enums -W clippy::exhaustive_structs -W clippy::indexing_slicing -W clippy::iter_over_hash_type -W clippy::map_err_ignore -W clippy::missing_errors_doc -W clippy::missing_panics_doc -W clippy::missing_safety_doc -W clippy::needless_range_loop -W clippy::new_without_default -W clippy::ptr_arg -W clippy::redundant_clone -W clippy::result_unit_err -W clippy::should_implement_trait -W clippy::string_add -W clippy::undocumented_unsafe_blocks -W clippy::unnecessary_unwrap -W clippy::unwrap_used -W clippy::wildcard_imports -W clippy::wrong_self_convention -W missing_debug_implementations -W missing_docs

findings.message: docs for function which may panic missing `# Panics` section
findings.fix: Add # Panics, or remove the panic.
Propagate with ?, or use expect and state why the value cannot be missing.

findings.message: public fn exposes a boxed dynamic error
findings.fix: Return a named error type; keep the boxed form inside binaries.

findings.message: public fn exposes a boxed dynamic error
findings.fix: Return a named error type; keep the boxed form inside binaries.

findings.message: public fn exposes an anyhow type
findings.fix: Return a named error type and let the application wrap it with anyhow.

findings.message: catch_unwind with no comment naming the boundary
findings.fix: Return a Result instead, or comment the boundary that needs the catch.

findings.message: public fn takes a bool parameter
findings.fix: Use a two-variant enum, or split into two named functions.

findings.message: type name says nothing about what it models
findings.fix: Name the type for the thing it models.
Use from_le_bytes, TryFrom, a match, or a safe wrapper type.

findings.message: unsafe impl of Send or Sync with no SAFETY comment
findings.fix: Fix the type so the auto trait holds, or document the invariant that makes it sound.
Hide a fn main returning Result in the example and use ?.
Remove it and pass -D warnings in CI.
Propagate the poison, or reset the data with a reason on record.

judgment.rule: A trait that outsiders should only use, never implement, is sealed.
A library follows the API rules strictly; an application keeps its code plain.
A function must not take ownership and then clone, or borrow and then clone to get ownership.
impl Into parameters earn their cost only in library entry points that are called often.
A library function returns an iterator when it would otherwise build a Vec just to hand it over.
Public fields, Rc, RefCell, Arc and third-party types do not leak through a public signature.
Callers' closures are not run while a lock is held, and a guard is not returned.
A doc comment opens with a one-line summary that adds information beyond the name.
Every public error type implements Display and Error, and is Send, Sync and 'static.
Error text names the file, line or value that failed, and the underlying cause stays reachable.
Pick match or a combinator by which reads better; use a loop when a chain gets long.
No clone exists only to quiet the borrow checker.
Arithmetic on outside values must not overflow into a panic or a wrong answer.
Each expect, assert and panic message carries the values that made it fire.
An expected failure is returned as an error, never raised as a panic or caught with catch_unwind.
A Drop impl never panics, blocks or has a failure path of its own.
Logic that decides something has a test that would fail if the logic broke.
A test checks behavior, not a copy of the constants it was built from.
A hand-written Ord agrees with the PartialEq and Hash on the same type.
Public types derive the common traits that fit them: Clone, Eq, Hash, Default and so on.
A safe function must not allow undefined behavior through any sequence of safe calls.
